Review Season Kit

Built for managers of all levels writing year-end reviews, and for anyone writing a self-evaluation. Every phrase follows one rule: describe what the person did, why it mattered, and what happens next.

Includes guidance for the hard cases: remote employees, top performers, people who are great at the job but hard to work with, former peers, a hard personal year, and reviews that may lead to a PIP.

This kit offers general guidance on writing reviews. It is not legal or HR advice.

What you get

  • Quick start: how to use the kit, the formula and a 6-week review timeline
  • Phrase bank: 300 phrases across 10 skill areas and 3 rating levels
  • Special cases for remote employees, top performers, former peers and more
  • 5 conversation scripts plus a 15-minute meeting agenda
  • Self-evaluation template with a filled-in example
  • Pre-submit checklist with words to avoid and a calibration cheat sheet
